## Assistant

Recursion is a fundamental concept in computer science.
Recursion involves a function calling itself.
Recursion requires a base case to avoid infinite loops.
Recursion can be replaced with iteration in most cases.
Recursion is used in tree traversal algorithms.
Recursion is elegant but can cause stack overflow if too deep.
